lines.text: Guard your steps when you go to the house of God, and draw near to listen.
Do not be hasty to utter a word before God, because God is in heaven and you are on earth.
As a dream comes through many cares, so the speech of a king comes with many words.
Do not delay in fulfilling a vow to God, because it is better to make a smaller vow than to break one.
Do not tell the messenger that your vow was a mistake, and fear God.
